# FG-DB-0007

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_stale_worker_is_fenced_and_the_newer_result_is_kept` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: バックグラウンドの処理をやり直しています。
- en: A background task is being retried.
- id: Tugas latar belakang sedang dicoba ulang.

## 原因 (cause)

A job's run or lease ended before its result was recorded normally. reason=lease_expired: the reaper found a running job past lease_until (= claim + timeout_ms + 30 s: the worker crashed, was killed, or its run was cancelled) and queued it again after the backoff; fenced: a worker tried to record a result (or release the job) for a lease it no longer holds (reaped and re-claimed) — the result was discarded and the newer one kept; execution_timeout: the handler ran longer than the job's timeout_ms and was aborted (retried after the backoff; kept under this code because it is the runner ending the lease early); abort_pending: an aborted handler (after its timeout or a stop) did not end within 5 s (it blocks without awaiting) — followed by left_leased; released_on_shutdown: forge worker stopped while the job ran, the handler was aborted after the 10 s grace and the job was handed back (queued, ready now, the attempt not counted); left_leased (`after` = execution_timeout or shutdown): the aborted handler did not end, so the job keeps its lease and only the reaper makes it claimable after the lease expires — the old run never overlaps the next attempt; release_timeout: the hand-back at shutdown did not answer in 5 s — its outcome is unknown: it may still apply later (fenced; the handler has ended) or the lease expires. Jobs run at least once: a handler may run again after this.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The event carries `reason`, `job_id`, `kind`, `worker_id` (the lease holder: `w<pid>-<random>` of a forge worker process), `attempt`, `origin_request_id`, and for execution_timeout `timeout_ms`, for abort_pending `wait_ms`; its request_id is the job's origin request id. Look for the worker's own log around the time (a restart, `forge.worker.stopped`, a crash) and for the same job_id's earlier lines. Several lease_expired or released_on_shutdown lines after a worker restart are expected (one per job that was running). Repeated execution_timeout or abort_pending for one kind means its timeout is too short or the handler hangs on an external call without a timeout. A timeout whose handler does not end logs execution_timeout, then abort_pending, then left_leased; a stop whose handler does not end logs abort_pending, then left_leased (after=shutdown). A stop waits at most about 20 s for the job runner (10 s grace + 5 s abort wait + 5 s hand-back).

## 対処 (fix)

Usually none: the job is retried. Repeated for one kind: fix the handler (an unbounded or blocking wait) or raise that kind's timeout in code. A job that keeps expiring ends as FG-DB-0006 when its attempts are used up.
